## Purpose
`/remote-servers`: all remote servers, grouped by purpose (workflow deployment, tool deployment). It has a health summary, check-all, provider accounts, bulk delete and a get-started guide.

## Responsibilities
`RemoteServersPage`:
- reads `remoteServersApi.list` and `providers`;
- `ServerCard` grid (`CardGrid`);
- `HealthSummary` (`healthOf`);
- `checkAll`: "Checked: N healthy, N degraded, N unreachable.";
- `ProviderAccounts`;
- bulk `remove`;
- `GetStarted`;
- the empty state "No remote servers yet".

Titled "Remote Servers — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`RemoteServersPage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
Diagnostics and deletion.
